```{r}
#| label: setup
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(here)
  library(data.table)
})
here::i_am("reports-src/slides.qmd")
source(here("R/utils/config.R"))
load_config()
invisible(list2env(
  readRDS(get_data_path("outputs", "summary_env")), environment()
))

# Formatting only: every number comes from summary_env.rds (03)
num.fn <- function(x) sub("^-", "−", sprintf("%.0f", x))
range.fn <- function(x) {
  paste(num.fn(x$lower), "to", num.fn(x$upper))
}
difference.fn <- function(s) differences[species == s]
est.fn <- function(s) paste(num.fn(difference.fn(s)$estimate), "g")
n.fn <- function(s) means[species == s, sum(n)]
largest <- differences[which.max(estimate), species]
spread <- paste(num.fn(min(differences$estimate)), "to",
                num.fn(max(differences$estimate)), "g")
dropped.v <- data$dropped_by_species[, sprintf("%d %s", N, species)]
ci_pct <- 100 * ci_level
# Tables: row labels left, numbers right (docs/STYLE.md)
table.fn <- function(table.dt) {
  knitr::kable(table.dt, format = "html",
               align = c("l", rep("r", ncol(table.dt) - 1)))
}
# Slide figures (02), drawn at the size of their slide area
figure.fn <- function(path) {
  stopifnot(file.exists(path))
  knitr::include_graphics(path)
}

# Claims the slides make, checked against the numbers
stopifnot(
  all(differences$lower > 0),
  model$male$lower > 0,
  model$chinstrap$lower < 0, model$chinstrap$upper > 0,
  # The species terms in the speaker notes
  model$gentoo$lower > 0
)
```

## How much heavier are males, and does it depend on the species? {data-part="Question and data"}

:::: {.split .wide-right}
::: {}
```{r}
table.fn(data.table(
  ` ` = c("Measured", "Analysed", "Years"),
  Penguins = c(data$penguins, data$complete,
               sprintf("%d–%d", data$years[1], data$years[2]))
))
```

a measurement.]{.statement}

## Males are heavier in every species {data-part="Results"}

```{r}
#| fig-alt: "Body mass of each penguin by species, females and males, with means"
figure.fn(slide_figure)
```

[`r data$complete` penguins. Points: individual penguins. Black: means with
`r ci_pct`% confidence intervals.]{.caption}

## The difference is largest in `r largest` penguins {data-part="Results · Within species"}

:::: {.split}
::: {}
```{r}
#| fig-alt: "Male minus female body mass within each species, with the model's single difference"
figure.fn(differences_figure)
```
:::

::: {}
```{r}
table.fn(differences[, .(
  Species = as.character(species), `Difference (g)` = num.fn(estimate),
  `95% CI (g)` = paste(num.fn(lower), "to", num.fn(upper))
)])
```

::: {.statements}
[**Adjusted for species,** males are heavier by
`r num.fn(model$male$estimate)` g (`r range.fn(model$male)`); R²
`r sprintf("%.2f", model$r_squared)`.]{.statement}

[**One difference for all species:** the model assumes it; within species
it ranges from `r spread`.]{.statement}
:::
:::
::::

[Male minus female mean body mass, with Welch `r ci_pct`% confidence
intervals. Dashed: the model's difference, adjusted for species.]{.caption}

::: {.notes}
Linear model of body mass on species and sex, `r model$n` penguins.
Chinstrap vs Adelie: `r num.fn(model$chinstrap$estimate)` g
(`r range.fn(model$chinstrap)`); Gentoo vs Adelie:
`r num.fn(model$gentoo$estimate)` g (`r range.fn(model$gentoo)`).
:::
